notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.focusEnabledDescription: Push notifications, app badges, and unread emphasis are paused on every Nessie device.
notifications.focusDisabledDescription: Pause push notifications and mute attention cues on every device while you work.
notifications.deliveryDescription: Every type starts enabled. Nessie skips delivery only when a focused app is already showing that exact conversation or page. When you are elsewhere in Nessie, desktop and browser sessions show a banner and registered devices receive the system notification.
notifications.channelMessagesDescription: New posts in channels you belong to.
notifications.budgetAlertsDescription: Operational budget warnings and blocks for organisation owners.
notifications.scheduledFailuresDescription: A scheduled task that stopped running and needs attention.
notifications.assignedWorkDescription: Project work assigned to you by another person.
notifications.publishedKnowledgeDescription: Knowledge pages newly published where you have access.
notifications.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support web push notifications.
notifications.browserNotConfigured: Browser notifications are not configured on this instance.
notifications.browserBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser settings to enable.
notifications.browserEnabled: Enabled for this organisation on this browser
notifications.browserDisabledToast: Browser notifications disabled for this organisation.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: What you are doing, shown beside your name. Each one can carry a schedule that turns it on by itself, and contact rules that decide who still reaches you.
statuses.clearFailed: Your active status could not be cleared. It is still showing.
statuses.empty: No statuses yet. Add one to say what you are doing.
statuses.responseAgentActive: Response agent answers during this status
statuses.createDescription: A status says what you are doing. Its schedules and contact rules are set on its own screen.
statuses.label: Label
statuses.noContactRules: No contact rules yet — the response agent uses its default instructions.
statuses.noSchedules: No schedules yet — this status only applies when set active.
statuses.notFound: This status could not be found. It may have been deleted.
statuses.responseAgentDescription: Use these instructions when someone contacts you during this status.
statuses.deleteConfirmation: This also removes its schedules and contact rules.

team.name: Name
team.renameHelp: This name belongs to your UnlikeOtherAI team. Saving renames it there, so it changes in every other UnlikeOtherAI product too.
team.renameInactiveHelp: This name belongs to your UnlikeOtherAI team, and UnlikeOtherAI only accepts the change from inside it. Switch to this team to rename it.
team.addressHelp: This is your team’s address. Changing it changes the web address people use to reach it, and the old one stops working — {{slug}}.{{domain}}.
team.avatarTypeError: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
team.avatarSizeError: The image must be under 1 MB.
team.avatarDescription: The company picture for {{team}}, held by UnlikeOtherAI and shown anywhere the team appears — including in every other UnlikeOtherAI product. Separate from the organization logo, which is the whole tenant’s brand mark.
team.avatarFileHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 1 MB. Square images work best. Removing it falls back to the team icon or a generated image.
team.avatarOwnerOnly: Only organization owners and admins can change the team avatar.
team.avatarActiveTeamOnly: UnlikeOtherAI only accepts this change from inside the team. Switch to it to change its picture.

organization.name: Name
organization.managedNameHelp: This name belongs to your UnlikeOtherAI organization. Saving renames it there, so it changes on the sign-in screen and in every other UnlikeOtherAI product too.
organization.logoDescription: The logo for {{organization}}, shown in the sidebar and on the sign-in screen.
organization.logoFileHint: PNG or JPG. Square images work best.
organization.logoCropDescription: Drag to reposition, scroll, or use the slider to zoom. The framed area becomes your logo.
organization.themeSaved: Theme saved. It's now the default for everyone in {{organization}} who hasn't chosen one.
organization.themeDescription: Your organization’s own colors, offered to everyone in {{organization}} as a theme and used by default for anyone who hasn’t chosen one. People can still pick any theme, including High Contrast.
organization.noTheme: No theme yet. Start from the colors below and replace the accent with your brand color.
organization.appearanceHelp: Whether text is dark on light, or light on dark. The background and sidebar must match this.
organization.accentHelp: Buttons, links, selection, and the active item. Your brand's primary color.
organization.backgroundHelp: The color pages sit on. Keep it near-white for a light theme or near-black for a dark one — strong color here makes text hard to read.
organization.sidebarHelp: The navigation column. Derived from your accent unless you set it.
organization.previewNotice: You’re seeing the draft. Your own theme comes back when you leave this page — choose {{organization}} under Account → Appearance to keep it.
organization.removeThemeConfirmation: Everyone who hasn’t chosen a theme goes back to Sandstone. People who chose {{organization}} will see Sandstone until a theme is saved again.
organization.callsDescription: Choose the provider used when someone starts a call in each team.
organization.providerUnavailable: {{provider}} is not configured for this deployment.
organization.noCallProviders: No call providers are configured for this deployment.
organization.providerSaveFailed: Failed to save the call provider.
organization.callsCreateLink: Calls in this team create a {{provider}} link.

surface-band.label: Background
surface-band.light: For a light theme the background must be light — something like #f8fafc.
surface-band.dark: For a dark theme the background must be dark — something like #14171c.

surface-chroma.label: Background
surface-chroma.detail: The background is too colourful for text to sit on. Keep it near neutral and put the colour in the accent or the sidebar.

sidebar-band.label: Sidebar
sidebar-band.detail: The sidebar must be as dark (or light) as the background — they share the same text colours.

accent-on-main.label: Accent on background
accent-on-main.detail: The accent doesn’t stand out against the background ({{ratio}}:1; needs 3:1). Choose a brighter or darker accent, or adjust the background.

accent-on-panel.label: Accent on cards
accent-on-panel.detail: The accent doesn’t stand out against cards ({{ratio}}:1; needs 3:1). Choose a brighter or darker accent, or adjust the background.

accent-on-sidebar.label: Accent on sidebar
accent-on-sidebar.detail: The highlighted item in the navigation will be faint ({{ratio}}:1).

accent-near-danger.label: Accent and errors
accent-near-danger.detail: Your accent is close to the red used for errors, so destructive buttons will look like ordinary ones.

secrets.revokeConfirmation: “{{name}}” will stop working anywhere it is bound.
secrets.withheldScope: Saved as your own secret. Only an organization owner can save a {{scopes}} secret.

pairedAgents.title: Paired agents
pairedAgents.description: Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients, working in Nessie as you. A paired agent reaches exactly what you reach and never more, and it cannot publish a document on its own — that comes back to you as an approval. Everything you lend here you can take back here.
pairedAgents.empty: Nothing paired yet. No program is holding a credential for your account.
pairedAgents.revokeFailed: That credential could not be revoked. It is still live.
pairedAgents.notFound: This credential could not be found. It may already have been removed.
pairedAgents.decisionFailed: That decision could not be recorded. Try again.
pairedAgents.dialogDescription: Ask the agent to connect to Nessie. It prints a link and a short code — open the link, or type the code here.
pairedAgents.chooseContext: Pick an active project and team first — a paired agent is scoped to one, and pairing cannot be completed without it.
pairedAgents.allowed: Paired. The agent picks up its credential within a few seconds.
pairedAgents.refused: Refused. The agent was told to stop asking.
pairedAgents.invalidCode: That code is not valid. It may have expired, or already been used — ask the agent for a new one.
pairedAgents.wantsToWorkUntil: wants to work as you until {{date}}.
pairedAgents.verifyClient: Only allow this if you just ran a tool that printed this code. The name above is whatever that tool calls itself, and nothing checks it.

boards_read.label: Read boards
boards_read.detail: See your boards and the tasks on them, including boards mirrored from Linear.

boards_write.label: Change boards
boards_write.detail: Create tasks, edit them, and move them between columns.

documents_read.label: Read documents
documents_read.detail: Read the knowledge spaces and documents you can read.

documents_write.label: Write documents as drafts
documents_write.detail: Create and edit documents as drafts. Publishing one still comes to you as an approval — an agent can ask, but it cannot publish.
